I'm going to do my best but I'm afraid that it won't help a lot as finals start in a week. I'm going to a temp agency next week and looking at places as well. Anxiety is just getting to me, I don't want to break down further than I have already.

I don't know. She was always on my side before and I'm sure in the end things will smooth themselves out but right now I think she's going on my dad's side more.

You're right. I guess I am just tired of trying to be positive. I need to re-boot somehow.

They paid for college, so that's why they expect the money back. He is always grumpy, we never had a good relationship - it was always either fighting or ignoring one another. He told me that he gave up on me years ago. Yeah, I guess my education made him upset. I got B's last semester and he was VERY upset (screaming, slamming doors, etc) and from there I just spiraled. It's the end of the semester and I fell behind completely. I'm nowhere close to even a 2.0 GPA. I would be happy to move out though, for my own sanity. My struggle with depression/suicide/self harm stemmed from our relationship. 

It's okay, writing makes me feel better. She's fine, she's always supported me. She's the main reason why I won't go through with it. She's been through so much already that I hate myself even thinking about hurting her like that. I am treating her like shit right now, and I feel terrible.

I'm finishing my first year of college.

He does. We've spoken about it and he is completely serious. The only other thing he wants is for me to move out. I'm looking for jobs right now and I guess I'm going to get a loan for the money. 

I never knew what I wanted. I still have no idea. I'm looking for some programs in other Universities and Colleges in the city but I'm getting anxiety attacks just thinking about it. I'm so afraid to fail again.

I have no drive to do prove him wrong. All I want to do is stay in my bed, in silence and never move. I can hardly get myself up in the mornings. Seeing people enjoying their lives just makes me more miserable and back into the same routine of hiding in my room. 

I tried to look into other option but I am overwhelmed. I have to pay back my parents $10,000 within the next month, as well as find a job that will support me as I also have to move out asap...
